title: VCO • pinned Cathay counters

title: CA • Cathay’s 8.0 rework
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Primary patch notes for the Military/Provinces technology split, buildings, commandments, Alchemist and Gate Master changes. Names shared with older technologies can now have different effects. Tiger Warrior additions are distinguished from Bhashiva’s exclusive campaign systems.

title: CA • 8.1 landmarks and caravan skills
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Primary details for House of Secrets at Shang-Yang, Terracotta Road, naval landmark, new caravan attrition skills and other updates. The patch text gives House of Secrets income as 500; the indexed game-data page gives 300. The atlas deliberately does not base a budget on either number.

title: CA • Caravan improvements
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Primary update introducing two simultaneously active Cathayan caravans and additional destination rewards. Later technology can increase the active limit further. Current dispatch UI, not an old single-caravan guide, is authoritative.

title: CA • provincial Harmony rework
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Official Grand Cathay developer update for the 4.0 rework. Campaign Harmony is provincial and building-driven, separate from the proximity system used in battles. There is no need to alternate research or recruit heroes to repair a faction-wide Yin/Yang total.

title: Wu Xing Compass • current cross-check
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Secondary reference for the four ordinary directions, cooldown/energy behaviour and updated Warpstone Desert caravan bonuses. Read exact scope in the game. Zhao does not choose Yuan Bo’s extra directions or construct his astromantic relays.

title: Harmony • provincial and battle rules
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Secondary cross-check of the post-rework provincial building balance and the separate battle-proximity rule. The atlas calculates only your entered Yin/Yang arithmetic; it does not invent exact income or growth output from that total.

title: Western Provinces • Immortal Empires start
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Secondary starting-position cross-check: Qiang in the Wastelands of Jinshen for Immortal Empires. Hanyu Port is the local capital to secure, not a reason to import a Realms of Chaos opening. Starting treaties and nearby owners should be rechecked in your save.

title: CA • Bhashiva and the Bone Road
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Bhashiva’s start and Tiger Warrior expansion. Her Vale of Titans / Bone Road position matters for Route III. title: The Great Embassy • tier-five landmark
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Shang-Yang, Warpstone Desert, tier 5. This is Route I’s required building, distinct from House of Secrets. Base construction prices and durations change with your modifiers; use the current cost in your budget.

title: House of Secrets • tier-three landmark
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Tier-three Shang-Yang landmark: Alchemist access/capacity/recruit-rank and elixir support. Its income differs between the public 8.1 patch description and the indexed data. Use your in-game preview; neither the Embassy requirement nor the recommended building order depends on that disputed income.

title: Cathay building reference
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Building-chain reference for the Western Provinces. Do not import Commercial District or Fortress City modifiers from a Celestial Court faction page. Construction recipes are spending priorities, with capital tier, slots and local resources determining what actually fits.

title: Celestial Barracks • recruitment gate
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Tier-four Celestial Barracks recruits Celestial Dragon Guard. The upgraded Celestial Armoury supplies the advanced crossbow troops. This is late recruitment, not a prerequisite for the opening war.

title: Tea Parlour • Yin development
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Yin growth branch with provincial economic support. It excludes the Yang conscription branch in the same settlement. Opposite branches can instead be assigned to different towns in the same province.

title: Labour Conscription Bureau • Yang development
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Yang growth/construction branch. Read local-province scope and any conditional modifiers; do not treat every displayed faction-specific modifier as a global Zhao bonus.

title: Spice Market • Yin income chain
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Ordinary Yin income and trade support. The counterpart is Wares Market / Merchant Caravans / Trade Exchange. The building called Merchant Caravans is not an extra active caravan slot.

title: Smart Autoresolve • working assumption
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. The exact Smart Autoresolve pack was not available for inspection. This is a Workshop directory, not a claimed mod-specific source. The atlas assumes the user’s named mod is enabled and avoids vanilla ranged-bias exploits, invented matchup multipliers and promises about active-ability scoring. Army compositions have not been benchmarked under that pack.

title: Ivory Road • caravan operation
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Secondary operational reference for dispatch, route events, cargo, return times, destination rewards and caravan roster development. title: Celestial Tower • lions and Astromancer
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Tier-three Celestial Tower recruits the Astromancer and the Celestial/Jade/Jet Lion families. Ignore the conditional IsJadeDragonFortressCity effect: that is not an ordinary Zhao Ming bonus.

title: Jade Barracks • Gate Master access
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Tier-three Jade Barracks provides Gate Master recruitment/capacity, Jade Halberds and shielded Jade crossbows. Its conditional Jade Dragon Fortress City recruitment modifier is not counted for Zhao.

title: Fire Rain Silo • artillery tier
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Tier-four Fire Rain Silo recruits the Rocket Battery. The preceding Powder Magazine is the practical tier-three Cannon/Crane/War Drum gate. Conditional Celestial Court effects are not counted.

title: Iron Claw Barracks • ordinary Cathay
note: Archive annotation; not independently checked in this registration package. Tier-four ordinary Cathay building unlocks Iron Claw Tiger Warriors and Clawspeaker recruitment/capacity. Bhashiva has a separate version with different prices/bonuses; this atlas does not substitute it.
